fullContentHtml:
RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Exam City Details 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the Exam City Details for the RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Posts Post on the official website of RRB. This recruitment was released for 3058 posts. Applications for the RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 30 December 2025, to 29 January 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 14-15 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Short Notice Date : 17 December 225
  • Starting Date : 30 December 2025
  • Last Date for Apply : 29 January 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 31 January 2026
  • Form Correction / Modified Date : 01 – 10 February 2026
  • Application Status : 11 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 14-15 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 04 July 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS, : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.

What is RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Exam City Details 2026?

RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Exam City Details 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

The last date to apply is 29 January 2026.
